name: IGG Inc
summary: IGG Inc, an investment holding company, develops and operates mobile and online games in Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers mobile, and client and browser based PC online games, including lords mobile; doomsday: last survivors; viking rise; and other. It also licenses online games; researches, develops, and operates mobile application; and provides customer support, technical maintenance, and technical support services. IGG Inc was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Singapore.
